definitions.short: to sell , literally (as merchandise, a daughter in marriage, into slavery), or figuratively (to surrender )
definitions.full: H4376. makar מָכַר verb sell (Late Hebrew id. ; Phoenician מכר ; Zinjirli מכרו price , DHM Sendsch. 60 ; Aramaic , מְכַר marry (i.e. buy as a wife); compare Assyrian makkûru, namkur(r)u , nakkuru , possession , property , Dl HWB 408 ); — Qal Perfect ׳מ Lev 27:20 2 t.; suffix מְכָרוֺ Exodus 21:37 2 t.; 1 singular מָכַרְתִּי Isa 50:1-2 t., etc.; Imperfect יִמְכֹּר Exod 21:7 +, etc.; Imperative מִכְרָ֫ה Gen 25:31 ; feminine singular מִכְרִי 2Kin 4:7 ; Infinitive absolute מָכֹר Deut 14:21 ; 21:14 ; construct מְכוֺר Neh 10:32 ; suffix מָכְרָהּ Exod 21:8 ; מִכְרָם Amos 2:6 ; Neh 13:15 (compare Ba NB 104 ); Participle מֹכֵר ( מוֺכֵר ) Lev 25:16 3 t.; feminine מֹכֶרֶת Nahum 3:4 , etc.; — sell (with בְּ pret.
